verdict.rationale: Reconciliation artifacts are a fair axis for a card-issuing platform, but the evidence pack never mentions settlement files, settlement or report APIs, or interchange, fee, or network-adjustment reporting. The only related items are funding-balance access and general 'full transaction visibility' for agent cards. Those are adjacent features, not machine-readable reconciliation artifacts, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I get machine-readable reconciliation artifacts — daily settlement files or report APIs covering interchange, fees, and network adjustments — that my finance stack can consume automatically
